subject: general
question: The second five-year plan gave high priority to industrial development aimed at setting up a number of heavy industries such as steel plants, capital goods industries, etc., for which direct government participation and state involvement was needed and hence the _______ was launched.
solution:
The correct answer is__ __**__Industrial Policy Resolution 1956__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Industrial Policy Resolution 1956

 
 
• The **establishment **of several heavy **industries**, including **steel plants** and **capital goods sectors**, was a top objective for the **second five-year plan**. Since these businesses required direct government involvement and the state, the Industrial Policy Resolution** 1956** was established.
 
• After the Industrial Policy of **1948**, it was India's second in-depth pronouncement on** industrial growth**.
 
• For a very long time, the** 1956** policy remained the cornerstone of **economic policy**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian five-year plans**. This resolution states that the **establishment **of a **socialistic social structure** was the goal of India's **social **and **economic policy**. It gave the **governmental apparatus** more authority.
 
• The** IPR 1956** also emphasised the need to provide facilities for **employees**, a favourable attitude toward foreign **investment**, and fair and non-discriminatory treatment for the** private sector**. It also encouraged **village **and **small-scale firms** and worked to eliminate **regional inequities**.
